g.text: Load the groups assigned to the admin
Admin enters the image repository tag, selects the
Compute Group, maps data to a Storage Group folder,
selects Docker or Podman and clicks Deploy.
[Caller may not create containers or use the chosen groups]
[Compute Group or Storage Group does not exist]
[Data invalid (empty image tag, path outside Storage Group)]
Insert approved Storage Group host paths
[Engine daemon does not answer in time]
No answer from the engine daemon
Save generated Compose file as draft
